reference: f113d73f (rev 26) - the binary that measured the 6482.7 us ratchet
method: CPU-only build in container subha_k1, four TUs from identical sources differing only in -D; unbundled with clang-offload-bundler --type=o --unbundle --targets=hipv4-amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx950, then llvm-objcopy --dump-section=.text, then sha256
note_src_rev: K0P6_MPS_SRC_REV moved 29 -> 30. It does not participate in codegen (the value is never read; only its presence in the JIT cache key matters), which is why the bump is compatible with .text identity.
gate_verdict: REF == DEF byte for byte. M14 and RING both differ from REF, which is the other half of the gate: a flag-on build that came out identical would mean the flag was not reaching the code and the arm would be a lie.

site_ablation.method: Each mode-14 #if was renamed to a per-site macro and built with exactly one site live, so the perturbation can be charged to specific edits rather than to 'mode 14' as a blob.
site_ablation.discriminating_column: epilogue_collapses - whether the site independently collapses the M7 epilogue's atomic issue window. Code size is NOT the variable.

sites.what: kernel entry guard, row_ready tail index

site_ablation.finding: Four of the nine sites each independently collapse the M7 epilogue's injection window, and five do not touch it at all. S9 adds the single largest lump of new code (+5568 B of .text, +50 scratch ops) and is INERT on the epilogue, while S4 - one line, 'if (k0p6_m == 14ull) return;', on a branch that is unreachable at runtime in that build because config_is_valid still rejects mode 14 - is one of the two worst.

culprit.verdict: the mode-14 code, NOT the exp_23 ring
evidence: The +726.9 us was measured at pin 291dfa08 = rev 28. The ring is a rev-29 change and was not in that tree at all.
DEF has the ring code present in the file with K0P6_MPS_E23_RING 0, and DEF is byte-identical to REF, so K0P6_MPS_ENABLE_MODE14 is the necessary and sufficient guard.
With the ring compiled IN, the M7 epilogue's injection window is identical to rev 26 on every metric; its +128 B of .text is entirely outside the epilogue.
culprit.ring_disposition: Demoted to default-off anyway, because it cannot meet .text identity by construction (it adds a store at every stamped boundary). It is not accused; it is held to the gate we now trust, and it was never GPU-timed, so it will be timed as its own arm.

flags.what: compiles in all nine mode-14 sites. =1 reproduces exp_34's arms and carries the +727 us. Never publish a mode-12 number from a =1 binary.
compiles in the exp_23 per-CTA phase ring. =1 reproduces exp_23's figure arms.
gate-only; folds the ring's runtime enable to compile-time true. Never in a shipped build.
